name: Violent Child
body:
You blend the magical with the martial.

Prerequisite: Magical child 1st.

Benefit(s): Add 1 spell per spell level from the magus spell list to the unchained summoner spell list with the magical child vigilante archetype.

Special: A magical child can choose to gain this feat in place of their 1st-level social talent. This feat can be selected multiple times, each time adding 1 new spell per level.
